rows.title: Small encounter
rows.effect: A random crew member must sit out this fight. Reduce enemy numbers by -1 (-2 if they initially outnumber you)

rows.title: Poor visibility
rows.effect: Maximum visibility is 1D6+8”. Reroll at the start of each round.

rows.title: Brief engagement
rows.effect: At the end of each round, roll 2D6. If the roll is equal or below the round number, the game ends inconclusively.

rows.title: Toxic environment
rows.effect: Whenever a combatant is Stunned, roll 1D6+Savvy skill (0 for enemies). Failure to roll a 4+ becomes a casualty.

rows.title: Surprise encounter
rows.effect: The enemy can’t act in the first round.

rows.title: Delayed
rows.effect: 2 random crew members won’t start on the table. At the end of each round, roll 1D6: If the roll is equal or below the round number, they may be placed at any point of your own battlefield edge.

rows.title: Slippery ground
rows.effect: All movement at ground level is -1 Speed.

rows.title: Caught off guard
rows.effect: Your squad all act in the Slow Actions phase in Round 1.

rows.title: Gloomy
rows.effect: Maximum visibility is 9”. Characters that fire can be fired upon at any range, however.
